b.memo: Garmin Ltd. (GRMN) presents a compelling 'Strong Buy' case due to its impressive growth trajectory and robust financial health. Furthermore, the company's commitment to shareholder value is evident through a 17% dividend increase and a $500 million share repurchase program. With a history of S&P 500-beating performance and strong earnings revisions, Garmin is well-positioned for continued growth.

Furthermore, the stock' a decline in share price and negative technical signals make it a risky play at this moment. Therefore, the technical weakness and inflated P/E ratio relative to peers drive a sell decision.
